To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the hybrid composition containing 30 wt% of polyester and 10 wt% of kaolin showed the best results in terms of tensile and impact adhesive strength, flexural strength, and impact strength.

the addition of reactive polyester and the kaolin to brittle epoxy resin improves mechanical properties as well as adhesive properties under tensile and shear conditions, and that hybrid compositions containing 30wt.% of polyester and kaolin show a synergic effect on tensile adhesive strength and impact adhesive strength in relation to the virgin epoxy.

the hybrid composition containing 30 wt. % of polyester and 20 wt. % of kaolin showed the best mechanical and adhesive properties, with the best impact adhesive strength, which was 2.6 times higher than that of the epoxy resin without modifiers.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the preparation and characterization of a new type of hybrid epoxy resin toughened by reactive polyester and kaolinite, which is a low-cost material and environmentally friendly, with a high potential for industrial application in the automotive industry, as well as in other sectors.
the preparation of a new hybrid material with enhanced mechanical properties and improved adhesive performance.
the preparation and properties evaluation of epoxy resin toughened by the combination of reactive polyester and Kaolin.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the hybrid system of kaolin and polyester is a promising toughening agent for epoxy resins.

the addition of the reactive polyester and kaolinite to the epoxy resin improved the mechanical and adhesive strength of brittle epoxy resin, with a synergic effect being obtained at a 30 wt.% content.
the hybrid compositions containing 30wt.% of polyester and kaolin showed improved mechanical and adhesive properties in comparison to the epoxy resin, exhibiting an additive effect.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a synergic effect of the two modifiers was achieved, resulting in an improvement of the mechanical and adhesive characteristics of the brittle epoxy resin.
the hybrid compositions of polyester/kaolin/epoxy resin showed improved mechanical and adhesive properties in comparison to the pure epoxy resin.
the addition of reactive polyester and Kaolin to the epoxy resin matrix resulted in a toughened epoxy resin with improved mechanical and adhesive properties.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the addition of kaolin to epoxy resin can enhance the impact strength, flexural strength, tensile adhesive strength and impact adhesive strength of the epoxy resin, and the addition of polyester can improve its flexural modulus.
a combination of reactive polyester and clay is a promising approach for toughening epoxy resins.
the combination of polyester and kaolin can be considered as a toughening agent for brittle epoxy resins.
